Conjecture
[Rational relations among Lobachevsky values] \group lobachevsky Source: thurston:page-0173

For rational multiples of $\pi $, every rational linear relation among values of $\Lambda $ follows from oddness, period $\pi $, and the multiplication identity. Equivalently, for $N\geq 3$, the values \[ \{ \Lambda (\pi j/N):0<j<N/2,\ \gcd (j,N)=1\} \] are rationally linearly independent, so their span has dimension $\varphi (N)/2$.
